text:
emma_cs: customer reports intermittent SSE disconnects ~10-20s into stream, only for some sessions, very spikey today. attached request ids: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e
emma_cs: they say auth is via short-lived signed cookie, rotated every 15s by their infra. suspect cookie refresh race. can we get a curl repro to validate?
ryan_oncall: can you paste the raw request headers and x-request-id from one failure?
emma_cs: from logs: 
- x-request-id: r-0a1b2c3d
- x-trace-id: trace-9f8e7d
- Cookie: __sse_sig=eyJhbGciOi...; Path=/sse; HttpOnly
- Upgrade: keep-alive

emma_cs: they used nginx proxy in front, maybe chunked disconnect.
ivan_infra: ok i'll draft a conservative curl that mirrors SSE + cookie rotation. please have the customer run this from their environment.
ivan_infra: ```bash
# streaming curl that prints headers and keeps connection open
curl --no-buffer -i -N \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Cookie: __sse_sig=REPLACE_COOKIE" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3d" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=test-model"
```
ivan_infra: if it disconnects, run again with `--trace-ascii curl.trace` and upload that file. also ask them to run `tcpdump -s 0 -w sse.pcap port 443` if they can (helpful for proxy).
maria_support: also request a small debug bundle: full request headers + the failing server logs around that request id and nginx access/error logs for the time window. we need token expiry timestamps too.
emma_cs: customer says they tried a similar curl but got 401 on retry when cookie rotated. they can reproduce locally but only when their refresh occurs during handshake.
ivan_infra: note: if cookie rotates mid-handshake, server should accept the original cookie until handshake finishes. ask them to confirm server's cookie validation window.
emma_cs: I'm going to send the curl above but with notes: replace REPLACE_COOKIE with the signed cookie value, run for ~30s, include --trace-ascii if fails, attach curl.trace and any nginx logs.
emma_cs: tagging @ryan_oncall for oncall review if we see repeated disconnects, may need temporary fallback to token auth. :warning:
ryan_oncall: ack. if they supply trace + pcap + logs we can correlate TLS sessions and check for RST/FIN vs graceful close. will triage asap.
deploy-bot: new debug bundle requested by emma_cs: bundle-id db-1961234567; please upload to /support-debug/1961234567 when ready.
emma_cs: thanks — sent steps to customer. will post results when they upload artifacts. :thumbsup:
